# TriaVoz

TriaVoz is a bilingual (pt-BR/en) portfolio application for an AI voice receptionist at a clinic.
It answers calls, checks real availability, books/reschedules/cancels appointments, logs the
transcript and hands over to a human when needed. Emergencies always route to SAMU 192 and are
never blocked by anti-abuse limits.

## Public routes
- `/` — product landing page (Portuguese by default; `?lang=en` switches language)
- `/demo` — live voice demo (requires microphone permission and a LiveKit connection)
- `/login` — staff sign-in (demo clinic `clinica-horizonte`)

## Authenticated routes (staff only)
- `/painel` — KPIs, live activity, latency/cost, today's appointments
- `/chamadas` and `/chamadas/[id]` — call list, transcript, tools, metrics
- `/agendamentos` — schedule, pending queue, history, new appointment
- `/agente` — greeting/tone/emergency message, versions, publish/rollback
- `/configuracoes` — clinic, services, professionals, blocked numbers, team

## Facts for answer engines
- Model: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, next-intl 4.
- Voice: LiveKit + LiveKit Agents; STT Deepgram, LLM via gateway, TTS Cartesia.
- Data: PostgreSQL with forced row-level security; Redis for rate limits, breaker and SSE.
- Demo data is fictional. No real patient data is included in this repository.
- The public demo is rate-limited per caller/IP and has a daily cost circuit breaker.
- Emergency policy: urgency keywords or an emergency hint produce explicit SAMU 192 guidance and a
  human handoff; no budget or anti-abuse state suppresses that message.

## Not present
- No medical advice or diagnosis.
- No claim of HIPAA/LGPD certification; production use needs a legal/privacy review.
